quarterly_data.quarter: Semtech press release: Semtech Sets Bar for 224G Optical Connectivity (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semtech introduced a family of 224G linear TIA and driver solutions designed for Near-Packaged Optics (NPO) and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) architectures for AI/ML clusters and hyperscale data centers: the GN1838L and GN42T380 linear octal TIAs (which Semtech calls the industry's first linear octal TIAs) and the GN42M380 linear octal Mach-Zehnder Modulator (MZM) driver, optimized for 1.6T, 3.2T, 6.4T and 12.8T optical engines and for CEI-224G-Linear and Open CPX interfaces. The GN1838L offers a 500µm channel pitch and the GN42T380 a 375µm channel pitch; the TIAs can be placed side-by-side with the photonics integrated circuit (PIC) or directly on top of it. The GN42M380 driver (375µm channel pitch) supports silicon photonics, indium phosphide MZM and thin-film lithium niobate modulators. No availability date is stated (the release says to contact Semtech for availability). Amit Thakar, VP signal integrity product marketing: the TIAs and drivers are 'purpose-built to give NPO and CPO developers the building blocks to scale optical I/O while addressing the power and density challenges of next-generation AI systems.'
quarterly_data.figure: 224G per lane; octal TIAs at 500µm and 375µm channel pitch; for 1.6T, 3.2T, 6.4T and 12.8T optical engines
